summary: Changes how Memos gets its version number: development/canary/manual builds now use the commit date as YY.MM instead of 'dev'/last tag/'manual-sha', and the server now refuses to start (exits) if it was built without a valid YY.MM version; the Docker build now fails unless a VERSION build argument is passed.

statements.why: No login, data, money or secret change. The new startup check is an operational risk (see misses) but not one of the danger categories.

misses.what: The server now refuses to start if it was built without a valid YY.MM version (e.g. built from source without Git info, or `go run` without -buildvcs=true); anyone building Memos themselves could get an app that won't start.
Building the Docker image yourself now fails unless you pass --build-arg VERSION=... (scripts/Dockerfile).
The version shown in the app and API for canary/dev/manual builds changes (e.g. '26.10' instead of 'dev', the last tag, or 'manual-<sha>').
